title.sl: Do takrat: I'll have finished, I'll be working
title.de: Bis dahin: I'll have finished, I'll be working
title.it: Entro allora: I'll have finished, I'll be working

goal.sl: Poveš, kaj bo do nekega časa že narejeno (By Friday I'll have finished), kako dolgo že takrat, in ločiš by in until.
goal.de: Du sagst, was bis zu einem Zeitpunkt fertig sein wird (By Friday I'll have finished) und wie lange dann schon, und unterscheidest by und until.
goal.it: Dici che cosa sarà fatto entro un certo momento (By Friday I'll have finished) e da quanto tempo, e distingui by e until.
goal.en: You can say what will be done by a certain time (By Friday I'll have finished) and how long by then, and tell by and until apart.

say.sl: **will have** + deležnik pove, kaj bo do nekega časa že narejeno. **By Friday I'll have finished the gate.** (Do petka bom {m:dokončal|f:dokončala} vrata.) **By noon Mrs Birkett will have baked the scones.** (Do poldneva bo Mrs Birkett spekla sconese.)
say.de: **will have** + Partizip sagt, was bis zu einem Zeitpunkt fertig sein wird. **By Friday I'll have finished the gate.** (Bis Freitag werde ich das Tor fertig haben.) **By noon Mrs Birkett will have baked the scones.** (Bis Mittag wird Mrs Birkett die Scones gebacken haben.)
say.it: **will have** + participio dice che cosa sarà fatto entro un certo momento. **By Friday I'll have finished the gate.** (Entro venerdì avrò finito il cancello.) **By noon Mrs Birkett will have baked the scones.** (Entro mezzogiorno Mrs Birkett avrà sfornato gli scone.)
say.en: **will have** + the participle says what will be done by a certain time. **By Friday I'll have finished the gate.** **By noon Mrs Birkett will have baked the scones.**

examples.en: By Friday I'll have finished the gate.
examples.de: Bis Freitag werde ich das Tor fertig haben.
examples.it: Entro venerdì avrò finito il cancello.

examples.en: By noon Mrs Birkett will have baked the scones.
examples.sl: Do poldneva bo Mrs Birkett spekla sconese.
examples.de: Bis Mittag wird Mrs Birkett die Scones gebacken haben.
examples.it: Entro mezzogiorno Mrs Birkett avrà sfornato gli scone.

say.sl: Kratko **'ll have**, zanikano **won't have**, v vprašanju **will** spredaj: **We won't have finished by six.** (Do šestih ne bomo končali.) **Will you have finished by six?** (Boš do šestih {m:končal|f:končala}?) Tudi **already**: **She'll already have left.** (Takrat bo že odšla.)
say.de: Kurz **'ll have**, verneint **won't have**, in der Frage **will** vorn: **We won't have finished by six.** (Bis sechs werden wir nicht fertig sein.) **Will you have finished by six?** (Bist du bis sechs fertig?) Auch **already**: **She'll already have left.** (Dann ist sie schon weg.)
say.it: Breve **'ll have**, al negativo **won't have**, nella domanda **will** davanti: **We won't have finished by six.** (Entro le sei non avremo finito.) **Will you have finished by six?** (Avrai finito entro le sei?) Anche **already**: **She'll already have left.** (Sarà già partita.)
say.en: Short **'ll have**, with not **won't have**, and to ask, **will** comes first: **We won't have finished by six.** **Will you have finished by six?** Also **already**: **She'll already have left.**

examples.en: We won't have finished by six.
examples.de: Bis sechs werden wir nicht fertig sein.
examples.it: Entro le sei non avremo finito.

explain.sl:
**Do takrat narejeno: will have + deležnik**
- By the time you ring, she'll already have left.
explain.de:
**Bis dahin fertig: will have + Partizip**

explain.it:

say.sl: **by** pove zadnji trenutek, **until** pa, do kdaj traja: **Finish it by six.** (Končaj najpozneje do šestih.) **Wait until six.** (Počakaj do šestih.) Slovensko *do* je oboje. Tudi **by then** (do takrat): **By then we'll have eaten.**
say.de: **by** sagt den letzten Moment, **until**, wie lange es dauert: **Finish it by six.** (Mach es bis spätestens sechs fertig.) **Wait until six.** (Warte bis sechs.) Deutsch *bis* ist beides. Auch **by then** (bis dahin): **By then we'll have eaten.**
say.it: **by** dice il termine, **until** fino a quando: **Finish it by six.** (Finiscilo entro le sei.) **Wait until six.** (Aspetta fino alle sei.) L'italiano distingue *entro* e *fino a*. Anche **by then** (entro allora): **By then we'll have eaten.**
say.en: **by** says the last moment, **until** how long it goes on: **Finish it by six.** (not *Finish it until six*) **Wait until six.** Also **by then**: **By then we'll have eaten.**

examples.de: Mach es bis spätestens sechs fertig.

say.sl: **by the time** ima za sabo sedanjik: **By the time you get here, we'll have eaten.** (Ko boš {m:prišel|f:prišla}, bomo že pojedli.) Slovenščina reče tu prihodnjik, angleščina pa **you get**. Tako tudi **when** in **as soon as**.
say.de: **by the time** nimmt das Präsens: **By the time you get here, we'll have eaten.** (Bis du kommst, haben wir schon gegessen.) Wie Deutsch: **you get**, kein will. So auch **when** und **as soon as**.
say.it: **by the time** vuole il presente: **By the time you get here, we'll have eaten.** (Quando arriverai, avremo già mangiato.) L'italiano qui dice il futuro, l'inglese **you get**. Così anche **when** e **as soon as**.
say.en: **by the time** takes the present: **By the time you get here, we'll have eaten.** (not *By the time you will get here*) The same goes for **when** and **as soon as**.

examples.en: By the time you get here, we'll have eaten.
examples.de: Bis du kommst, haben wir schon gegessen.

say.sl: **will have been** + -ing pove, kako dolgo že takrat: **In June I'll have been living here for ten years.** (Junija bom tu {m:živel|f:živela} že deset let.) **will be** + -ing pa, kaj se bo ravno dogajalo: **At six I'll be cooking.** (Ob šestih bom ravno {m:kuhal|f:kuhala}.) **By six I'll have cooked dinner.** (Do šestih bom {m:skuhal|f:skuhala} večerjo.)
say.de: **will have been** + -ing sagt, wie lange dann schon: **In June I'll have been living here for ten years.** (Im Juni wohne ich schon zehn Jahre hier.) **will be** + -ing, was genau dann im Gang ist: **At six I'll be cooking.** (Um sechs werde ich gerade kochen.) **By six I'll have cooked dinner.** (Bis sechs werde ich das Abendessen gekocht haben.)
say.it: **will have been** + -ing dice da quanto tempo, allora: **In June I'll have been living here for ten years.** (A giugno abiterò qui da dieci anni.) **will be** + -ing ciò che sarà in corso proprio allora: **At six I'll be cooking.** (Alle sei starò cucinando.) **By six I'll have cooked dinner.** (Entro le sei avrò preparato la cena.)
say.en: **will have been** + -ing says how long, by then: **In June I'll have been living here for ten years.** **will be** + -ing says what will be going on at that moment: **At six I'll be cooking.** **By six I'll have cooked dinner.**

say.sl: **will have** pove tudi domnevo o sedanjosti: **Jack will have got home by now.** (Jack je zdaj gotovo že doma.) **You'll have heard the news.** (Novico si gotovo že {m:slišal|f:slišala}.) V govoru je **I'll've**, zato ljudje pišejo tudi *I'll of*. Pisno velja **I'll have**.
say.de: **will have** drückt auch eine Vermutung über die Gegenwart aus: **Jack will have got home by now.** (Jack wird jetzt schon daheim sein.) **You'll have heard the news.** (Du hast die Neuigkeit sicher schon gehört.) Gesprochen ist es **I'll've**, darum schreibt man auch *I'll of*. Geschrieben gilt **I'll have**.
say.it: **will have** dice anche un'ipotesi sul presente: **Jack will have got home by now.** (Jack sarà già a casa.) **You'll have heard the news.** (Avrai già sentito la notizia.) A voce è **I'll've**, perciò si scrive anche *I'll of*. Per iscritto vale **I'll have**.
say.en: **will have** also says what you suppose about now: **Jack will have got home by now.** **You'll have heard the news.** In talk it's **I'll've**, so people also write *I'll of*. Writing wants **I'll have**.

examples.en: Jack will have got home by now.
examples.sl: Jack je zdaj gotovo že doma.
examples.de: Jack wird jetzt schon daheim sein.
Du hast die Neuigkeit sicher schon gehört.

exercises.title: Mrs Hartley's note
exercises.text: The show is on Saturday. By Thursday Mr Dixon ___ (already mend) the gate. By Friday morning Mrs Birkett ___ (bake) two hundred scones. At three on Friday we ___ (put) up the tents, so please don't ring. By the time the visitors ___ (come), everything will be ready. By then Arthur ___ (keep) bees for forty-nine years, and by lunch he ___ (tell) everyone. I ___ (see) you there at ten!

accept: will already have mended
will have already mended
will have baked
will be putting
are putting
come
will have kept
will have been keeping
will have told
will see
will be seeing

translation.sl: Razstava je v soboto. Do četrtka bo Mr Dixon že popravil vrata. Do petka zjutraj bo Mrs Birkett spekla dvesto sconesov. V petek ob treh bomo ravno postavljali šotore, zato prosim ne kličite. Ko bodo prišli obiskovalci, bo vse pripravljeno. Takrat bo Arthur čebelaril že devetinštirideset let, in do kosila bo to povedal vsem. Se vidimo tam ob desetih!
translation.de: Die Ausstellung ist am Samstag. Bis Donnerstag wird Mr Dixon das Tor schon repariert haben. Bis Freitag früh wird Mrs Birkett zweihundert Scones gebacken haben. Am Freitag um drei stellen wir gerade die Zelte auf, also bitte nicht anrufen. Bis die Besucher kommen, ist alles fertig. Bis dahin hält Arthur schon neunundvierzig Jahre Bienen, und bis Mittag wird er es allen erzählt haben. Wir sehen uns dort um zehn!
translation.it: La fiera è sabato. Entro giovedì Mr Dixon avrà già riparato il cancello. Entro venerdì mattina Mrs Birkett avrà sfornato duecento scone. Venerdì alle tre staremo montando le tende, quindi per favore non telefonate. Quando arriveranno i visitatori, sarà tutto pronto. A quel punto Arthur terrà api da quarantanove anni, ed entro pranzo lo avrà detto a tutti. Ci vediamo lì alle dieci!
translation.en: The show is on Saturday. By Thursday Mr Dixon will already have mended the gate. By Friday morning Mrs Birkett will have baked two hundred scones. At three on Friday we'll be putting up the tents, so please don't ring. By the time the visitors come, everything will be ready. By then Arthur will have kept bees for forty-nine years, and by lunch he will have told everyone. I'll see you there at ten!

exercises.title: Mrs Birkett's message
exercises.text: Your bus gets in at eight, but by the time you ___ (get) here, the kitchen will be closed. We ___ (eat) by then. At eight I ___ (wash) up, so come round the back. In May we ___ (run) the inn for twenty years! You ___ (hear) that already, I expect.

accept: get
will have eaten
will be washing
will have been running
will have run
will have heard

translation.sl: Tvoj avtobus pride ob osmih, ampak ko boš {m:prišel|f:prišla} sem, bo kuhinja že zaprta. Takrat bomo že pojedli. Ob osmih bom ravno pomivala, zato pridi na zadnja vrata. Maja bomo gostilno vodili že dvajset let! To si gotovo že {m:slišal|f:slišala}.
translation.de: Dein Bus kommt um acht an, aber bis du da bist, ist die Küche zu. Bis dahin haben wir gegessen. Um acht wasche ich gerade ab, also komm hinten herum. Im Mai führen wir das Gasthaus schon zwanzig Jahre! Das hast du sicher schon gehört.
translation.it: Il tuo autobus arriva alle otto, ma quando arriverai qui, la cucina sarà chiusa. A quel punto avremo già mangiato. Alle otto starò lavando i piatti, quindi passa dal retro. A maggio gestiremo la locanda da vent'anni! L'avrai già sentito, immagino.
translation.en: Your bus gets in at eight, but by the time you get here, the kitchen will be closed. We'll have eaten by then. At eight I'll be washing up, so come round the back. In May we'll have been running the inn for twenty years! You'll have heard that already, I expect.
